title: Zun`Muram Shaldn Boc
summary: Shaldn Boc alternates increasingly long rages with shorter periods of weakness.
overview: Shaldn Boc alternates increasingly long rages with shorter periods of weakness.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Rotate defensive coverage during rages and recover during the weakened intervals.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The first rage begins after 35 seconds in combat.
As health decreases, rage increases melee strength and attack speed and lasts from 20 up to 65 seconds.
Each rage ends in a 35-second weakened interval before the next begins.
At 90%, the room seals. Thirty seconds out of combat resets health, melee tuning and the room.

notes: Approval E336. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
